title: Tenis to Pickleball Transition (Michelle Grogan)
style: latin reggaeton cumbia salsa fusion 132bpm timbales conga bongo guiro marimba trumpet trombone slap bass spanish guitar dembow chorus claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
De la cancha grande
A la cancha pequena
Pickleball es nuevo
Vamos a aprender

[Verse 1]
Paddle es mas pequena que raqueta
Grip continental no eastern
Swing path mas corto siempre
No backswing como tenis
Vamos vamos paddle quieta
Uno dos tres swing pequeneta
Third shot drop is the new shot
Not the deep approach you forgot

[Pre-Chorus]
Shorter swing
Softer touch
Shorter swing
Win so much

[Chorus]
De tenis a pickleball de tenis a pickleball
Swing mas corto suave swing mas corto
De tenis a pickleball de tenis a pickleball
Vamos amigos shorter shorter

[Verse 2]
Tennis serve goes high and deep
Pickle serve underhand below the waist keep
Tennis volley follow through full
Pickle volley short punch firm wool
Uno dos tres compact swing
Mano firme paddle the wing
Kitchen line is new for you
Seven feet from the net is true

[Bridge]
No swing high above the head
Underhand serve calm instead
The drop shot is your new tool
Arc the ball stay cool stay cool

[Chorus]
De tenis a pickleball de tenis a pickleball
Swing mas corto suave swing mas corto
De tenis a pickleball de tenis a pickleball
Vamos amigos shorter shorter

[Outro]
Shorter swing
Softer touch
Shorter swing
Win so much
